COMMUNICATION

You Should Always KnowWhat’s Happening.

01

Clear milestones

The project is broken into stages with agreed outcomes.

02

Visible progress

You can see what’s done, what’s in progress and what’s next.

03

Regular communication

Updates at points we agree together, so there are no surprises.

04

Documented decisions

Key choices are written down, so everyone stays aligned.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

Seven things that make a project move faster.

Don’t have everything ready? That’s fine. We’ll help you work out the rest.

  • Business context

    What your business does, who your customers are and how you earn.

  • Project objective

    What you want this project to achieve.

  • Brand assets

    Logo, colours, fonts and photos, if you have them.

  • Existing systems

    Your current website, tools or software we may need to connect.

  • Content

    Text, images and service or product details. We can help plan it.

  • Feedback

    Clear, timely comments at each review point.

  • Decision maker

    One person who can approve work at each stage.
